landing.heroSubtitle: Connect your AI agents to X. Post tweets, send replies, follow users, send DMs — all through the MCP protocol.
landing.feature1Desc: Post, reply, quote, retweet, like, follow, DM, delete — execute all write operations via MCP tools.
landing.feature2Desc: Search tweets, fetch user data, read timelines, track trending topics.
landing.feature3Desc: Monitor accounts and topics in real time, trigger your systems with HMAC-signed webhook delivery.
landing.how1Desc: Sign up with your email or social account in seconds.
landing.how2Desc: Create your API key from the panel and connect your X account.
landing.how3Desc: Connect Claude Code or any MCP client and start running X actions.
landing.betaText: Open beta — use it for free, share your feedback.

guide.title: Quick Start
guide.subtitle: Connect xtweetly to Claude Code in 5 minutes.
guide.step1Desc: Enter your X session credentials (auth_token, ct0, twid) on the Accounts page.
guide.step2Desc: Create a new key from the API Keys page. Select "Full Access". You'll see the key only once — copy it immediately.
guide.step3Desc: Go to your Dashboard — it shows the ready-to-paste command with your actual server URL and API key prefix pre-filled.
guide.step4Desc: Just ask Claude naturally — it will pick the right tool:
guide.trouble1: Invalid API key: make sure it starts with tk_.
guide.trouble2: MCP not connecting: verify the URL — copy it fresh from the Dashboard.
guide.trouble3: Action failed: check error details on the /actions page.

notFound.title: This page is not in the timeline
notFound.subtitle: The route you tried to reach doesn't exist — either it never did, or it moved.

hero.subtitle: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, and any MCP-aware client connect directly to xtweetly. One-click via OAuth or paste an API key — both are live.
hero.helper: Streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1 (PKCE-S256). DCR is automatic — no need to mint client_id/secret.

clients.title: Pick your client
clients.helper: OAuth clients authenticate in the browser — no API key needed. For CLI / legacy clients, use a tk_ key.

noAccount.title: Don't have an account?
noAccount.body: Sign in with a magic link in 30 seconds — connect your X account, then come back here for API key or OAuth flow.

developer.title: Building your own MCP client?
developer.body: Standard MCP 2025-06-18 + RFC 9728 + RFC 8414. Discovery starts at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. PKCE S256 required; refresh tokens not yet issued (tk_* are long-lived).

claudeDesktop.name: Claude Desktop
claudeDesktop.step2: Paste the URL; leave OAuth fields blank (DCR is automatic)
claudeDesktop.step3: Add → sign in to xtweetly in the browser → Allow

claudeWeb.name: Claude.ai (web)
claudeWeb.step3: Approve in browser → ready when the tools list loads

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT (Connectors)
chatgpt.step1: Settings → Connectors → Add → Custom MCP server
chatgpt.step3: In any chat: type @xtweetly to call tools

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.step1: Settings (⌘,) → MCP & Integrations → + Add custom MCP → HTTP
cursor.step2: Name: xtweetly, paste the URL → Save
cursor.step3: Cursor opens OAuth in browser → allow → tools appear in Composer

codex.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
codex.blurb: Remote HTTP MCP support. Config file.
codex.step2: Run codex — the terminal starts the OAuth flow

claudeCode.name: Claude Code (CLI)
claudeCode.blurb: Legacy SSE transport + tk_* API key.
claudeCode.step1: Panel → API Keys → + New Key (Full access) → copy the secret
claudeCode.step3: Run claude — type /mcp to confirm the tools loaded
